title: Lesson 19 - Streaming Data Transforms and Real-Time Preparation
description: Explain data transformation capabilities within Data 360., focused on setting up a streaming data transform and preparing records in real time for downstream consumption.

questions.question: A developer finishes a streaming data transform and must correct a column name in the SQL after saving. What must they do?
options: Edit the transform and save again
Delete the transform and create a new one, because streaming transforms cannot be modified after saving
Pause the transform, edit it, then resume
Change the column at the target DMO and it updates automatically
questions.explanation: Streaming transforms activate on save and cannot be changed, so the only path is delete and recreate. The strongest distractor, editing and saving again, is wrong because an active streaming transform is not editable.

questions.question: While creating a streaming data transform, which setting creates fully qualified keys on a newly created target object?
options: The key qualifier, paired with a primary key field
questions.explanation: During target creation you choose a key qualifier to create fully qualified keys and then select a primary key field. The value suggestion distractor only offers valid values for fields, and the currency setting only normalizes multi-currency data.

questions.question: Which statement about a streaming data transform's source and target objects is TRUE?
options: They may be the same object
The target object cannot be created during setup
The source must always be a data lake object
questions.explanation: Help states that the source and target objects must be different objects. The distractor that the target cannot be created during setup is wrong because you can select Create New, and the source can be a data model object or a data lake object.
